editCoreSettings.geoTrackingTooltip: Global switch. When enabled, agents report their approximate location (corporate devices). History follows the check-history retention.
editCoreSettings.geoForceLocationTooltip: Global switch. When enabled, the agent turns on system location and the WiFi radio if they are off, so WiFi scanning works even on Windows 11 24H2 / Server 2025. Applies to corporate devices (no user opt-in). Requires fleet geolocation enabled.
editCoreSettings.geoGeofence: Alert when a machine leaves its site
editCoreSettings.geoGeofenceTooltip: Global switch. Compares each machine's MEASURED location (WiFi or OS-native) against its site coordinates and raises an alert when it exceeds the radius. Requires the site to have coordinates. Machines marked as allowed off-site are excluded. Approximate IP locations are never evaluated.
editCoreSettings.maintenanceAlertTooltip: Maintenance mode never expires on its own. Past the threshold, an email is sent for agents still flagged. One notice per agent per window.
editCoreSettings.lostWebcamTooltip: While a device is marked as lost, each cycle also takes a photo with its camera. Off by default.
editCoreSettings.lostWebcamWarning: The camera LED turns on and cannot be turned off: the photo is never invisible to whoever holds the device. Viewing it also requires the view-evidence permission.
editCoreSettings.lostAutoLock: Lock the session when marked lost
editCoreSettings.lostAutoLockTooltip: Marking a device as lost locks its session. Not immediately: evidence is collected during the silent window first, and only then is it locked, so it does not tip off whoever holds it.
editCoreSettings.lostNoHibernateTooltip: While the case is open, the device will not sleep or hibernate (not even when the lid closes), so it keeps reporting location and captures. Restored on recovery. Windows only for now.
editCoreSettings.lostWebcamOverrideTooltip: In a lost-device case, take a camera photo even if the global webcam switch is off. Recorded in the mark audit entry.
editCoreSettings.lostAlarmTooltip: Sound the device alarm when marked lost. Off by default; enable it only when you want to alert whoever is nearby.

agentDownload.title: Manual Installation Instructions
agentDownload.windowsIntro: Download the agent then run the following command from an elevated command prompt on the device you want to add.
agentDownload.darwinIntro: Run the following command from a terminal
agentDownload.descLogDebug: To enable verbose output during the install
agentDownload.descSilent: Do not popup any message boxes during install
agentDownload.descLocalMesh: To skip downloading the Mesh Agent during the install.
agentDownload.descMeshdir: Specify full path to the directory containing MeshAgent.exe if using custom agent branding
agentDownload.descDesc: Set agent description field during install
agentDownload.authNote: Note: the auth token above will be valid for {expires} hours.
agentDownload.winPsIntro: This script downloads the agent installer, installs it silently and enrolls it automatically. The client, site, enrollment token and API URL are already embedded. Run it from a PowerShell console opened as Administrator, on the device you want to add.
agentDownload.winPsAdminNote: The script requires Administrator privileges: it registers the service, adds Windows Defender exclusions and copies files into 'C:\Program Files'. Open PowerShell with 'Run as administrator'. The -ExecutionPolicy Bypass flag in the command lets the script run without changing the system policy.
agentDownload.winExeAdminNote: Run it from a command prompt (cmd.exe) opened as Administrator — not PowerShell (the command uses 'start' and '&&', valid only in cmd.exe). 'start /wait' waits for the installer to finish before enrolling. The installer runs silently (/VERYSILENT): it copies files into 'C:\Program Files', registers the 'observeragent' service and creates the uninstall entry; the second command enrolls the agent.
agentDownload.winUninstallNote: To uninstall, delete the agent from the Observer RMM console (Agents → delete) or use Windows 'Add or Remove Programs' (Observer Agent entry). The installer registers its own uninstaller, so removal is clean.
agentDownload.nixIntro: The script requires root and systemd. Run it on the target machine from an SSH session (with no graphical environment in the shell). No parameters are needed — the enrollment token, client, site and API URL are already embedded.
agentDownload.macIntro: The script requires root. Run it on the target Mac from a terminal. No parameters are needed — the enrollment token, client, site and API URL are already embedded.
agentDownload.nixHeadlessNote: Run the installer from a plain SSH session. If it reports a detected display, run 'unset DISPLAY' first and try again. Take Control / remote screen still works afterward — the mesh agent runs as a system service, independent of the installer shell.
agentDownload.macUninstallNote: To uninstall on macOS, delete the agent from the Observer RMM console (Agents → delete): that sends the uninstaller to the agent (removes the mesh node, unloads the launchd service and deletes the files). The downloaded script does not support an 'uninstall' argument.
agentDownload.descInsecure: Skip TLS certificate verification (self-signed / internal CA)

lostEquipment.exported: The case for {hostname} was downloaded. If the exporter lacks permission to view visual evidence, the document ships without images and says so on the cover.
lostEquipment.policyCaption: These values apply when a case leaves a countermeasure on "Inherit". They in turn override the global value, and the specific case can override them when marking. "Inherit" here defers to the global configuration.
lostEquipment.policyDelayHint: Empty = inherit (currently {value} min). 0 locks immediately; higher collects more evidence first.

timeline.title: {hostname} case
timeline.noCycles: No captures yet for this case. The device uploads the first one as soon as it learns it is flagged; if it is off or offline, it will do so when it reconnects.
timeline.noPoints: None of the cycles managed to determine a location.
timeline.reason_wayland_no_soportado: Wayland session: this device has no capture path available
timeline.reason_wayland_sin_autorizacion: Wayland session: capture must be authorized once from the device
timeline.reason_sin_herramienta: The device has no screen capture tool installed
timeline.reason_permiso_denegado: macOS has not granted the screen recording permission
timeline.reason_pantalla_en_negro: The capture came out black and was discarded
timeline.reason_pantalla_apagada: The device screen was off (screensaver or power saving)
timeline.reason_pantalla_bloqueada: The device was locked: the screen had nothing to capture
timeline.reason_so_no_soportado: This operating system does not capture the screen
timeline.reason_formato_no_soportado: The server rejected the file: not an image
timeline.reason_archivo_muy_grande: The server rejected the file: too large
timeline.reason_archivo_vacio: The server rejected the file: it was empty
timeline.retention: Evidence is deleted automatically after {days} days, or {closed} days after the case is closed
timeline.reason_camara_ocupada: Another program is using the camera
timeline.reason_camara_sin_imagen: The camera returned no image (cover on, darkness, or driver)
timeline.reason_permiso_denegado_camara: The system won't grant camera permission
timeline.reason_so_no_soportado_camara: This operating system cannot take camera photos

diskEncryption.title: Disk encryption
diskEncryption.windowsOnlyNotice: This panel covers Windows endpoints only: it is the only platform that reports encryption in this phase. macOS and Linux endpoints do not appear here.
diskEncryption.refreshAgentTooltip: Asks the agent to re-read the encryption state.
diskEncryption.refreshRequested: The endpoint was asked to re-measure. The data will update once the agent reports.
diskEncryption.agentOffline: The endpoint is offline: the command was not sent.
diskEncryption.notSupported: This endpoint does not offer BitLocker or does not expose the WMI encryption provider.
diskEncryption.queryError: Could not read the encryption state: {error}
diskEncryption.neverReported: This endpoint has not reported its encryption state yet.
diskEncryption.noVolumes: The endpoint reported no encryptable volumes.
